explanation: An event or point in the future when God will judge humanity and the world.
An expression meaning that something is about to happen soon.
A large gathering of locusts that destroys crops and vegetation, used here as a symbol of destruction and suffering.
The name of a hill in Jerusalem, often used to refer to the entire city or the Jewish people in general.
A title for God that emphasizes his sovereignty and authority over all things.
A feeling of remorse and sorrow over one's sins, along with a desire to change one's behavior and turn to God.
God's favor and protection, often shown through material and spiritual abundance.
In this context, God's act of sending the Holy Spirit to people to give them power and guidance.
To deliver God's message or predict future events under divine inspiration.
